tickerText: [TENNIS] Nitto ATP Finals Friday in Turin sends Carlos Alcaraz against home hope Flavio Cobolli from 2 p.m. after Ben Shelton and Alexander Zverev booked Saturday semis, with Medvedev and Tiafoe playing winner-takes-all at 8:30 p.m. for the last Ivan Lendl Group spot • [SQUASH] PSA China Open semifinals loom in Shanghai as Mostafa Asal and Youssef Ibrahim advance, while PSA World Championship tickets hit general sale at 3 p.m. GMT for March's British Airways ARC in London • [BADMINTON] LI-NING Hong Kong Open quarterfinals Friday at Kai Tak follow Rakshitha Ramraj's idol-slaying run ending 21-19, 21-16 to Pornpawee Chochuwong, with Kidambi Srikanth set for Kunlavut Vitidsarn • [PICKLEBALL] Proton Daytona Beach Open quarterfinals Thursday at Pictona pit John Lucian Goins against Eric Oncins and JW Johnson against Federico Staksrud as mixed and doubles QFs fill the $1M Open week • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender Muscat crowns men's and women's doubles Friday at Sultan Qaboos Sport Complex after teenager Sun Yang's 3-1 stunner over top seed Darko Jorgic, with singles finals looming Saturday

newsItems.title: Turin SF Lineup
newsItems.excerpt: Ben Shelton and Alexander Zverev advanced from the John McEnroe Group on Thursday, setting up Saturday semifinals while Friday's Alcaraz–Cobolli and Medvedev–Tiafoe matches decide the Ivan Lendl Group's last-four picture in Turin.

newsItems.title: Shanghai SF Bound
newsItems.excerpt: Egypt's Mostafa Asal and Youssef Ibrahim reached the PSA China Open semifinals in Shanghai, while fans can grab 2026–27 PSA World Championships tickets starting Friday for the British Airways ARC in London.

newsItems.title: Daytona QF Day
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Proton Daytona Beach Open hits quarterfinals Thursday at Pictona, with men's draws featuring Goins–Oncins and Staksrud–JW Johnson after Lenhard's 0-11 first-game comeback and Oncins' win over Bellamy.

newsItems.title: Muscat Doubles Finals
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Star Contender Muscat's doubles finals cap Friday in Oman after qualifier Sun Yang stunned No. 1 seed Darko Jorgic 13-11, 11-9, 9-11, 11-5, with singles champions crowned at Sultan Qaboos Sport Complex on Saturday.
